+HOOKS_BLOCK="$TMPWORK/hooks-block.md"
+render_hooks_block > "$HOOKS_BLOCK"
+HOOKS_REF_NEW="$TMPWORK/hooks-reference.md"
+N_GUARDS="$(jq '.guards | length' <<<"$MAP_JSON")"
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --check
+if (( DO_CHECK )); then
+    render_hooks_ref "$HOOKS_BLOCK" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW"
+    drift=0
+    if [[ ! -f "$OUT" ]] || ! cmp -s "$REGISTER_NEW" "$OUT"; then
+        echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: drift: $OUT differs from the generated register" >&2
+        diff -u "$OUT" "$REGISTER_NEW" 2>/dev/null | head -20 >&2 || true
+        drift=1
+    fi
+    if ! cmp -s "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF"; then
+        echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: drift: the guard-register table in $HOOKS_REF differs from the generated one" >&2
+        diff -u "$HOOKS_REF" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" 2>/dev/null | head -20 >&2 || true
+        drift=1
+    fi
+    if (( drift )); then
+        echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: $REGEN_HINT" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: in sync ($N_GUARDS guards)"
+    exit 0
+fi
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- yield
+SEGMENTS="$TMPWORK/segments"
+: > "$SEGMENTS"
+for f in "$AUDIT_LOG" "$AUDIT_LOG".*; do
+    [[ -e "$f" ]] || continue
+    [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || die 3 "audit log segment not readable: $f"
+    printf '%s\n' "$f" >> "$SEGMENTS"
+done
+N_SEGMENTS="$(wc -l < "$SEGMENTS" | tr -d ' ')"
+ROWS="$TMPWORK/audit.rows"
+: > "$ROWS"
+if [[ "$N_SEGMENTS" == "0" ]]; then
+    warn "no audit log at $AUDIT_LOG (or segments $AUDIT_LOG.*); the yield is empty"
+else
+    while IFS= read -r f; do cat -- "$f" >> "$ROWS"; printf '\n' >> "$ROWS"; done < "$SEGMENTS"
+fi
+
+TMP_PREFIX="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
+TMP_PREFIX="${TMP_PREFIX%/}/"
+MAIN_ROOT=""
+if common="$(cd "$ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; then
+    common="$(cd "$ROOT" && cd "$common" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || common=""
+    case "$common" in */.git) MAIN_ROOT="${common%/.git}" ;; esac
+fi
+
+# Heredoc classification: the FR-6 classifier when present (heredoc_nonexec <command>
+# returns 0 for a heredoc whose consumer does not execute it), else `<<` presence.
+NONEXEC_IDX='null'
+if [[ -f "$HEREDOC_LIB" ]] && grep -q '^heredoc_nonexec[[:space:]]*()' "$HEREDOC_LIB"; then
+    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
+    if source "$HEREDOC_LIB" 2>/dev/null && declare -F heredoc_nonexec >/dev/null; then
+        IDX_FILE="$TMPWORK/nonexec.idx"
+        : > "$IDX_FILE"
+        # Same row indexing as the join below: non-blank lines, in order. Commands travel base64-encoded.
+        while IFS="$US" read -r idx b64; do
+            [[ -n "$idx" ]] || continue
+            cmd="$(printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 --decode 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 -D 2>/dev/null || true)"
+            if heredoc_nonexec "$cmd" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$idx" >> "$IDX_FILE"; fi
+        done < <(jq -R -n -r '[inputs | select(test("\\S")) | (try fromjson catch null)] | to_entries[]
+                   | select((.value | type) == "object" and .value.action == "block" and ((.value.command // "") | tostring | contains("<<")))
+                   | "\(.key)\u001f\(.value.command | tostring | @base64)"' "$ROWS" 2>/dev/null)
+        NONEXEC_IDX="$(jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0) | tonumber)' "$IDX_FILE")"
+    fi
+fi
+
+YIELD_JSON="$(jq -R -n \
+    --argjson map "$MAP_JSON" \
+    --argjson hooks "$HOOKS_JSON" \
+    --argjson nonexec "$NONEXEC_IDX" \
+    --argjson now "$NOW_EPOCH" \
+    --argjson win "$WINDOW_DAYS" \
+    --argjson segs "$N_SEGMENTS" \
+    --argjson burst_rows "$BURST_ROWS" \
+    --arg tmp "$TMP_PREFIX" \
+    --arg root "$ROOT" \
+    --arg mainroot "$MAIN_ROOT" '
+  def epoch: (.ts // .timestamp // null) | if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
+  def under($r): . as $c | ($r != "") and ($c == $r or ($c | startswith($r + "/")));
+  def minute: (.ts // .timestamp // "") | tostring | .[0:16];
+  def replay($burst): (.replay == true)
+    or ((.cwd // "") | type == "string" and (startswith($tmp) or contains("/bats-run-") or contains("/bats.") or contains("/evals/results/") or contains("/sandbox/")))
+    or (minute | IN($burst[]));
+  def outside_repo: (.cwd // "") as $c | ($c | type == "string") and $c != "" and (($c | under($root)) or ($c | under($mainroot)) | not);
+  def verbs: ["rm","git","find","dd","mkfs","shred","truncate","kubectl","terraform","aws","gcloud","psql","mysql","DROP","DELETE","TRUNCATE"];
+  def destructive_start: (.command // "") | tostring | [splits("(;|&&|\\|\\||\\||\n)")] | map(sub("^\\s+"; "") | (split("\\s+"; null)[0] // "")) | any(.[]; IN(verbs[]));
+  def heredoc: if $nonexec == null then ((.command // "") | tostring | contains("<<")) else (._i | IN($nonexec[])) end;
+  def prose_class: (.pattern_id // "") | IN("SP-1", "FR-MERGE-2", "FR-2-AMBIGUOUS");
+  def likely_fp: heredoc or outside_repo or (prose_class and (destructive_start | not));
+  def day: strftime("%Y-%m-%d");
+  def origin_txt: .origin as $o | if ($o.ref | tostring | startswith($o.kind | tostring)) then ($o.ref | tostring) else "\($o.kind) \($o.ref)" end;
+  ($hooks | map({key: (.rel | split("/") | last | sub("\\.sh$"; "")), value: .id}) | from_entries) as $hookid
+  | ($map.guards | map(.id)) as $known
+  | [inputs | select(test("\\S")) | (try fromjson catch null)] as $raw
+  | ($raw | to_entries | map(.value as $v | if ($v | type) == "object" then ($v + {_i: .key}) else null end)) as $all
+  | ($all | map(select(. != null))) as $rows
+  | ($rows | length) as $read
+  | ($rows | map(select(.action == "block" or .hook == "implement-gate") | . + {_t: epoch})) as $cand
+  | ($cand | map(select(._t != null and ._t >= ($now - $win * 86400) and ._t <= ($now + 86400)))) as $inwin
+  | ($inwin | map(select(.action == "block" and .replay != true)) | group_by(minute)
+     | map(select(length >= $burst_rows) | .[0] | minute)) as $burst
+  | ($inwin | map(select(replay($burst) | not))) as $live
+  | ($live | map(
+      (if .hook == "block-destructive-bash" then
+         ["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"] + (if ((.pattern_id // "") | tostring | test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$")) then ["fence:" + .pattern_id] else [] end)
+       elif .hook == "implement-gate" then ["hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
+       elif ((.hook // "") | type) == "string" and $hookid[.hook] != null then [$hookid[.hook]]
+       else [] end) as $ids
+      | {ids: ($ids | map(select(IN($known[])))),
+         block: (.action == "block" or .action == "deny"),
+         telemetry: (.action == "telemetry" or .action == "ask"),
+         fp: ((.action == "block" or .action == "deny") and likely_fp),
+         t: ._t})) as $cls
+  | ($cls | map(.ids[]) | unique) as $seen
+  | (["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh", "hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
+     + ($map.guards | map(select(.kind == "fence") | .id)) + $seen | unique) as $writers
+  | ($map.guards | map(. as $g
+      | if ($g.id | IN($writers[])) then
+          ($cls | map(select(any(.ids[]; . == $g.id)))) as $mine
+          | ($mine | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | map(.t) | max) as $last
+          | {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: true,
+             blocks_30d: ($mine | map(select(.block)) | length),
+             likely_fp_30d: ($mine | map(select(.fp)) | length),
+             telemetry_30d: ($mine | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
+             last_real_catch: (if $last == null then "none in window" else ($last | day) end)}
+        else
+          {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: false,
+           blocks_30d: null, likely_fp_30d: null, telemetry_30d: null, last_real_catch: "n/a"}
+        end)) as $guards
+  | {
+      schema_version: 1,
+      generated_at: ($now | day),
+      window_days: $win,
+      scope: "host",
+      audit_segments: $segs,
+      audit_rows_read: $read,
+      audit_rows_unparseable: (($raw | length) - $read),
+      audit_rows_considered: ($inwin | length),
+      replay_rows_excluded: (($inwin | length) - ($live | length)),
+      replay_rows_by_rule: {
+        flag: ($inwin | map(select(.replay == true)) | length),
+        cwd: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and replay([]))) | length),
+        burst: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and (replay([]) | not) and replay($burst))) | length)
+      },
+      heuristic: "likely_fp = heredoc in the command OR cwd outside the repository OR (pattern SP-1, FR-MERGE-2 or FR-2-AMBIGUOUS with no destructive verb at statement start); real = block AND NOT likely_fp",
+      totals: {
+        guards: ($map.guards | length),
+        guards_without_origin: 0,
+        dormant: ($map.guards | map(select(.status == "dormant")) | length),
+        blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block)) | length),
+        real_blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | length),
+        likely_fp_30d: ($cls | map(select(.fp)) | length),
+        telemetry_30d: ($cls | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
+        unattributed_30d: ($cls | map(select(.ids | length == 0)) | length)
+      },
+      guards: $guards
+    }
+' "$ROWS")" || die 3 "the audit log could not be joined"
+
+render_yield_md() {
+    jq -r "$JQ_DEFS"'
+      def n: if . == null then "n/a" else tostring end;
+      . as $y
+      | "# Guard yield (host)",
+        "",
+        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh; untracked, host-local. The structural register is grimoires/loa/guards.md. -->",
+        "",
+        "- generated_at: \($y.generated_at)",
+        "- window_days: \($y.window_days)",
+        "- scope: \($y.scope)",
+        "- audit_segments: \($y.audit_segments)",
+        "- audit_rows_considered: \($y.audit_rows_considered)",
+        "- replay_rows_excluded: \($y.replay_rows_excluded) (flag \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.flag), cwd \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.cwd), burst \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.burst))",
+        "- audit_rows_unparseable: \($y.audit_rows_unparseable)",
+        "- totals: \($y.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \($y.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \($y.totals.telemetry_30d) telemetry, \($y.totals.unattributed_30d) unattributed",
+        "- heuristic: \($y.heuristic | cell)",
+        (kinds[] as $k | ($y.guards | map(select(.kind == $k))) as $rows | select($rows | length > 0)
+          | "",
+            "## \($k) (\($rows | length))",
+            "",
+            "| id | class | status | origin | knob | floor | registrations | blocks_30d | likely_fp_30d | telemetry_30d | last_real_catch |",
+            "|----|-------|--------|--------|------|-------|---------------|------------|---------------|---------------|-----------------|",
+            ($rows[] | "| \(.id | cell) | \(.class | cell) | \(.status | cell) | \(.origin | cell) | \(.knob | cell) | \(.floor | yesno) | \(regs) | \(.blocks_30d | n) | \(.likely_fp_30d | n) | \(.telemetry_30d | n) | \(.last_real_catch | cell) |"))
+    ' <<<"$YIELD_JSON"
+}
+
+YIELD_MD_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.md"
+YIELD_JSON_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.json"
+render_yield_md > "$YIELD_MD_NEW"
+jq '.' <<<"$YIELD_JSON" > "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"
+
+install_file "$REGISTER_NEW" "$OUT"
+install_file "$YIELD_MD_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.md"
+install_file "$YIELD_JSON_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.json"
+if (( DO_HOOKS_TABLE )); then
+    render_hooks_ref "$HOOKS_BLOCK" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW"
+    cmp -s "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF" || install_file "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF"
+fi
+
+summary="$(jq -r '"\(.totals.guards) guards (\(.totals.dormant) dormant); \(.window_days) d: \(.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \(.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \(.replay_rows_excluded) replay rows excluded; scope host"' <<<"$YIELD_JSON")"
+if (( DO_JSON )); then
+    cat "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"
+    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary" >&2
+else
+    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary"
+fi
+exit 0

+validate_sprint_kinds() {
+    local fence_src
+    if ! fence_src="$(cat "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/md-fence.awk" 2>/dev/null)" || [[ -z "$fence_src" ]]; then
+        violations+=("cannot read ${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/md-fence.awk; the sprint kind: check needs it (reinstall the framework scripts)")
+        return 0
+    fi
+    local plan_date
+    plan_date="$(LC_ALL=C awk "$fence_src"'
+        md_fence($0) { next }
+        /^## / { exit }
+        /^\*\*Date:?\*\*:?/ { if (match($0, /[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]/)) print substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH); exit }
+    ' "$FILE")"
+    local enforce=false canon="" root=""
+    if [[ -n "$plan_date" ]]; then
+        [[ "$plan_date" < "$KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM" ]] || enforce=true
+    else
+        canon="$(cd "$(dirname -- "$FILE")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)/$(basename -- "$FILE")" || canon=""
+        root="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || root=""
+        if [[ -n "$root" ]]; then
+            case "$canon" in
+                "${root}/grimoires/loa/archive/"*) ;;
+                "${root}/grimoires/loa/"*)
+                    violations+=("a sprint plan carries **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD in its header (before the first '## ' heading); ${FILE} has none that parses, so the kind: rule (from ${KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM}) cannot be judged")
+                    return 0 ;;
+            esac
+        fi
+    fi
+    local findings
+    findings="$(LC_ALL=C awk "$fence_src"'
+        function ntok(s,   n) {
+            n = 0
+            while (match(s, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:/)) { n++; s = substr(s, RSTART + RLENGTH) }
+            return n
+        }
+        md_fence($0) { next }
+        /^## / { insp = ($0 ~ /^## Sprint [0-9]/); sec = 0; next }
+        !insp { next }
+        /^### / {
+            sec = 0
+            if ($0 ~ /^### Technical Tasks[[:space:]]*$/) sec = 1
+            else if ($0 ~ /^### Task [0-9A-Za-z]+\.E2E([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)/) sec = 2
+            next
+        }
+        !sec || $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] / { next }
+        sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
+        {
+            raw = $0; t = raw
+            gsub(/`[^`]*`/, "", t)
+            n = ntok(t)
+            if (n == 0) { printf "M\t%d\t0\n", NR; next }
+            if (n > 1) { printf "D\t%d\t%d\n", NR, n; next }
+            if (raw !~ /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/) {
+                if (t ~ /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)/) printf "T\t%d\t0\n", NR
+                else printf "U\t%d\t0\n", NR
+                next
+            }
+            if (raw !~ /judgment[[:space:]]*$/) next
+            files = 0; code = 0; s = raw
+            while (match(s, /[A-Za-z0-9_.\/*-]+\.(sh|py|ts|js|md|yaml|yml|json|tsv|bats|txt|toml)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)/)) {
+                tok = substr(s, RSTART, RLENGTH); s = substr(s, RSTART + RLENGTH)
+                files++
+                if (tok ~ /\.(sh|py|ts)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)/) code++
+            }
+            v = tolower(t)
+            if ((files > 0 && files == code) || v ~ /(^|[^a-z0-9_])(script|lint|generate)([^a-z0-9_]|$)/) printf "J\t%d\t0\n", NR
+        }
+    ' "$FILE")"
+    [[ -n "$findings" ]] || return 0
+    local code ln extra
+    local -a bad=()
+    while IFS=$'\t' read -r code ln extra; do
+        case "$code" in
+            J) warnings+=("$FILE:$ln: a task tagged kind: judgment names only *.sh/*.py/*.ts files or the verbs script, lint, generate; if a script could do it reliably, tag it kind: mechanical") ;;
+            M) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line has no kind: token; end it with ' · kind: mechanical|judgment|operator'") ;;
+            D) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line carries ${extra} kind: tokens; keep exactly one, at the end of the line") ;;
+            T) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line has text after its kind: value; the kind: token ends the line") ;;
+            U) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line's kind: value is not one of mechanical, judgment, operator (lower case)") ;;
+        esac
+    done <<< "$findings"
+    [[ ${#bad[@]} -gt 0 ]] || return 0
+    if [[ "$enforce" == "true" ]]; then
+        local b
+        for b in "${bad[@]}"; do
+            violations+=("${b} (a plan dated ${plan_date}, on or after ${KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM}, tags every task; see planning-sprints/resources/templates/sprint-template.md)")
+        done
+    else
+        warnings+=("${plan_date:-undated} plan: ${#bad[@]} task line(s) without a valid kind: tag; the tag is required for plans dated from ${KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM}")
+    fi
+}

+# fails. Inline code spans are not tokens. A 'judgment' task that names only *.sh, *.py or
+# *.ts files, or the verbs script, lint or generate, WARNs (never fails).
+# @guard validator:sprint.kinds
+KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM="2026-10-14"

+validate_sprint_kinds() {
+    local fence_src
+    if ! fence_src="$(cat "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/md-fence.awk" 2>/dev/null)" || [[ -z "$fence_src" ]]; then
+        violations+=("cannot read ${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/md-fence.awk; the sprint kind: check needs it (reinstall the framework scripts)")
+        return 0
+    fi
+    local plan_date
+    plan_date="$(LC_ALL=C awk "$fence_src"'
+        md_fence($0) { next }
+        /^## / { exit }
+        /^\*\*Date:?\*\*:?/ { if (match($0, /[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]/)) print substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH); exit }
+    ' "$FILE")"
+    local enforce=false canon="" root=""
+    if [[ -n "$plan_date" ]]; then
+        [[ "$plan_date" < "$KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM" ]] || enforce=true
+    else
+        canon="$(cd "$(dirname -- "$FILE")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)/$(basename -- "$FILE")" || canon=""
+        root="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || root=""
+        if [[ -n "$root" ]]; then
+            case "$canon" in
+                "${root}/grimoires/loa/archive/"*) ;;
+                "${root}/grimoires/loa/"*)
+                    violations+=("a sprint plan carries **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD in its header (before the first '## ' heading); ${FILE} has none that parses, so the kind: rule (from ${KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM}) cannot be judged")
+                    return 0 ;;
+            esac
+        fi
+    fi
+    local findings
+    findings="$(LC_ALL=C awk "$fence_src"'
+        function ntok(s,   n) {
+            n = 0
+            while (match(s, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:/)) { n++; s = substr(s, RSTART + RLENGTH) }
+            return n
+        }
+        md_fence($0) { next }
+        /^## / { insp = ($0 ~ /^## Sprint [0-9]/); sec = 0; next }
+        !insp { next }
+        /^### / {
+            sec = 0
+            if ($0 ~ /^### Technical Tasks[[:space:]]*$/) sec = 1
+            else if ($0 ~ /^### Task [0-9A-Za-z]+\.E2E([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)/) sec = 2
+            next
+        }
+        !sec || $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] / { next }
+        sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
+        {
+            raw = $0; t = raw
+            gsub(/`[^`]*`/, "", t)
+            n = ntok(t)
+            if (n == 0) { printf "M\t%d\t0\n", NR; next }
+            if (n > 1) { printf "D\t%d\t%d\n", NR, n; next }
+            if (raw !~ /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/) {
+                if (t ~ /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)/) printf "T\t%d\t0\n", NR
+                else printf "U\t%d\t0\n", NR
+                next
+            }
+            if (raw !~ /judgment[[:space:]]*$/) next
+            files = 0; code = 0; s = raw
+            while (match(s, /[A-Za-z0-9_.\/*-]+\.(sh|py|ts|js|md|yaml|yml|json|tsv|bats|txt|toml)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)/)) {
+                tok = substr(s, RSTART, RLENGTH); s = substr(s, RSTART + RLENGTH)
+                files++
+                if (tok ~ /\.(sh|py|ts)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)/) code++
+            }
+            v = tolower(t)
+            if ((files > 0 && files == code) || v ~ /(^|[^a-z0-9_])(script|lint|generate)([^a-z0-9_]|$)/) printf "J\t%d\t0\n", NR
+        }
+    ' "$FILE")"
+    [[ -n "$findings" ]] || return 0
+    local code ln extra
+    local -a bad=()
+    while IFS=$'\t' read -r code ln extra; do
+        case "$code" in
+            J) warnings+=("$FILE:$ln: a task tagged kind: judgment names only *.sh/*.py/*.ts files or the verbs script, lint, generate; if a script could do it reliably, tag it kind: mechanical") ;;
+            M) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line has no kind: token; end it with ' · kind: mechanical|judgment|operator'") ;;
+            D) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line carries ${extra} kind: tokens; keep exactly one, at the end of the line") ;;
+            T) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line has text after its kind: value; the kind: token ends the line") ;;
+            U) bad+=("$FILE:$ln: a task line's kind: value is not one of mechanical, judgment, operator (lower case)") ;;
+        esac
+    done <<< "$findings"
+    [[ ${#bad[@]} -gt 0 ]] || return 0
+    if [[ "$enforce" == "true" ]]; then
+        local b
+        for b in "${bad[@]}"; do
+            violations+=("${b} (a plan dated ${plan_date}, on or after ${KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM}, tags every task; see planning-sprints/resources/templates/sprint-template.md)")
+        done
+    else
+        warnings+=("${plan_date:-undated} plan: ${#bad[@]} task line(s) without a valid kind: tag; the tag is required for plans dated from ${KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM}")
+    fi
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
+
+Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
+suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
+<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
+`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
+
+Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
+the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
+findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
+findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
+bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
+the verdict and the missed labels.
+
+Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
+  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
+                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
+                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
+                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
+                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
+  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
+                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
+  no recall loss  every rule holds:
+                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
+                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
+                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
+An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
+
+Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
+given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
+"""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+
+
+def load_yaml_subset(path):
+    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
+    import subprocess
+    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    return json.loads(out)
+
+
+def read_jsonl(path):
+    rows = []
+    if not os.path.isfile(path):
+        return rows
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        for line in fh:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if line:
+                try:
+                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
+                except ValueError:
+                    continue
+    return rows
+
+
+def mean(xs):
+    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
+    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
+
+
+def fmt(x, nd=3):
+    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
+
+
+def recall_details(row):
+    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
+        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
+            return g["details"]
+    return None
+
+
+def tokens(row):
+    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
+    if not u:
+        return None
+    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
+               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
+
+
+def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
+    if not sorted_xs:
+        return None
+    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
+    return sorted_xs[k]
+
+
+def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
+    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
+    if not deltas:
+        return None, None
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    n = len(deltas)
+    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
+    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
+    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
+
+
+class Arm:
+    def __init__(self, arm_id):
+        self.id = arm_id
+        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
+        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
+        self.cited = 0
+        self.refuted = 0
+        self.tokens = []
+        self.models = set()
+        self.sources = set()
+        self.done = 0
+        self.errors = 0
+        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
+        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
+        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
+        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
+
+    def add(self, row):
+        if row.get("status") != "completed":
+            self.errors += 1
+            return
+        d = recall_details(row)
+        if d is None:
+            self.errors += 1
+            return
+        self.done += 1
+        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
+        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
+        if d.get("recall") is not None:
+            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
+        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
+            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
+            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
+        t = tokens(row)
+        if t is not None:
+            self.tokens.append(t)
+        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
+        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
+        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
+            if out:
+                self.models.add(mid)
+        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
+        if fb:
+            self.fallback_trials += 1
+            for x in fb:
+                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
+        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
+        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
+            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+
+    def defect_fixtures(self):
+        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
+
+    def fixture_means(self):
+        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
+
+    def trial_means(self):
+        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
+        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
+            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
+                by_trial[t].append(r)
+        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
+
+    def refuted_share(self):
+        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
+
+
+def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
+    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
+    status = {}
+    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
+    if os.path.isfile(sp):
+        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
+    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
+    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
+    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
+    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
+    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
+    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
+    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
+    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
+    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
+    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
+    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
+
+    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
+    arms = {}
+    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
+        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
+        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
+        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
+            continue
+        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
+        if m.get("dry_run"):
+            continue
+        manifests.append(m)
+        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
+        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
+            if a not in planned_arms:
+                planned_arms.append(a)
+            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
+            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
+                arm.add(row)
+    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
+    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
+    complete = state == "complete"
+
+    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
+    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
+    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
+    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
+    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
+    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
+                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
+                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+
+    base = arms.get("baseline")
+    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
+    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
+    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
+    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
+    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
+
+    def coverage_gaps(arm):
+        gaps = []
+        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
+            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
+            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
+            if planted == 0:
+                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
+            if n < trials_required:
+                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
+        return gaps
+
+    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
+              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
+    out_lines.append(header)
+    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
+    details = []
+    verdicts = {}
+    for a in order:
+        arm = arms[a]
+        fm = arm.fixture_means()
+        tm = arm.trial_means()
+        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
+        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
+        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
+        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
+        rs = arm.refuted_share()
+        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
+        drop = lo = hi = None
+        reasons = []
+        if a == "baseline":
+            verdict = "(reference)"
+        else:
+            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
+            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
+            drop = mean(deltas)
+            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
+            if partial:
+                reasons.append("--partial report")
+            if not complete:
+                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
+            if base is None:
+                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
+            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
+            if gaps:
+                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
+            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
+            if len(mods) > 1:
+                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
+            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
+            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
+                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
+            if not deltas:
+                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
+            if reasons:
+                verdict = "inconclusive"
+            else:
+                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
+                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
+                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
+                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
+                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
+                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
+                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")

+                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
+                else:
+                    verdict = "recall loss"
+                    reasons.extend(violated)
+            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
+                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
+        verdicts[a] = verdict
+        out_lines.append(
+            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
+            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
+            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
+        if arm.fallback_trials:
+            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
+                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
+        if reasons:
+            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
+        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
+            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
+            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    if details:
+        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
+        out_lines.extend(details)
+        out_lines.append("")
+    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    for a in order:
+        arm = arms[a]
+        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
+        if not items:
+            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
+            continue
+        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
+        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
+        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    return state, verdicts
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
+    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
+        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
+    if not suites:
+        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    for s in suites:
+        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
+            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 2
+        st = {}
+        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
+        if os.path.isfile(sp):
+            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
+        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
+            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
+                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
+                  file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1

+    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
+    if args.partial:
+        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
+                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
+    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
+              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
+              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
+              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
+    for s in suites:
+        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
+    print(args.out)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
+
+Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
+suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
+<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
+`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
+
+Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
+the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
+findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
+findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
+bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
+the verdict and the missed labels.
+
+Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
+  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
+                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
+                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
+                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
+                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
+  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
+                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
+  no recall loss  every rule holds:
+                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
+                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
+                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
+An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
+
+Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
+given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
+"""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+
+
+def load_yaml_subset(path):
+    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
+    import subprocess
+    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    return json.loads(out)
+
+
+def read_jsonl(path):
+    rows = []
+    if not os.path.isfile(path):
+        return rows
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        for line in fh:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if line:
+                try:
+                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
+                except ValueError:
+                    continue
+    return rows
+
+
+def mean(xs):
+    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
+    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
+
+
+def fmt(x, nd=3):
+    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
+
+
+def recall_details(row):
+    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
+        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
+            return g["details"]
+    return None
+
+
+def tokens(row):
+    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
+    if not u:
+        return None
+    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
+               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
+
+
+def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
+    if not sorted_xs:
+        return None
+    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
+    return sorted_xs[k]
+
+
+def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
+    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
+    if not deltas:
+        return None, None
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    n = len(deltas)
+    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
+    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
+    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
+
+
+class Arm:
+    def __init__(self, arm_id):
+        self.id = arm_id
+        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
+        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
+        self.cited = 0
+        self.refuted = 0
+        self.tokens = []
+        self.models = set()
+        self.sources = set()
+        self.done = 0
+        self.errors = 0
+        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
+        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
+        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
+        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
+
+    def add(self, row):
+        if row.get("status") != "completed":
+            self.errors += 1
+            return
+        d = recall_details(row)
+        if d is None:
+            self.errors += 1
+            return
+        self.done += 1
+        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
+        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
+        if d.get("recall") is not None:
+            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
+        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
+            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
+            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
+        t = tokens(row)
+        if t is not None:
+            self.tokens.append(t)
+        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
+        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
+        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
+            if out:
+                self.models.add(mid)
+        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
+        if fb:
+            self.fallback_trials += 1
+            for x in fb:
+                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
+        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
+        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
+            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+
+    def defect_fixtures(self):
+        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
+
+    def fixture_means(self):
+        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
+
+    def trial_means(self):
+        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
+        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
+            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
+                by_trial[t].append(r)
+        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
+
+    def refuted_share(self):
+        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
+
+
+def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
+    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
+    status = {}
+    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
+    if os.path.isfile(sp):
+        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
+    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
+    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
+    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
+    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
+    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
+    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
+    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
+    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
+    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
+    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
+    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
+
+    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
+    arms = {}
+    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
+        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
+        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
+        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
+            continue
+        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
+        if m.get("dry_run"):
+            continue
+        manifests.append(m)
+        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
+        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
+            if a not in planned_arms:
+                planned_arms.append(a)
+            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
+            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
+                arm.add(row)
+    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
+    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
+    complete = state == "complete"
+
+    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
+    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
+    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
+    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
+    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
+    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
+                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
+                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+
+    base = arms.get("baseline")
+    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
+    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
+    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
+    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
+    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
+
+    def coverage_gaps(arm):
+        gaps = []
+        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
+            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
+            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
+            if planted == 0:
+                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
+            if n < trials_required:
+                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
+        return gaps
+
+    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
+              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
+    out_lines.append(header)
+    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
+    details = []
+    verdicts = {}
+    for a in order:
+        arm = arms[a]
+        fm = arm.fixture_means()
+        tm = arm.trial_means()
+        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
+        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
+        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
+        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
+        rs = arm.refuted_share()
+        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
+        drop = lo = hi = None
+        reasons = []
+        if a == "baseline":
+            verdict = "(reference)"
+        else:
+            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
+            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
+            drop = mean(deltas)
+            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
+            if partial:
+                reasons.append("--partial report")
+            if not complete:
+                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
+            if base is None:
+                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
+            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
+            if gaps:
+                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
+            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
+            if len(mods) > 1:
+                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
+            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
+            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
+                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
+            if not deltas:
+                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
+            if reasons:
+                verdict = "inconclusive"
+            else:
+                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
+                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
+                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
+                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
+                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
+                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
+                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
+                    refuted_violated = True
+                if not violated:
+                    verdict = "no recall loss"
+                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
+                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
+                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
+                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
+                    verdict = "inconclusive"
+                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
+                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
+                else:
+                    verdict = "recall loss"
+                    reasons.extend(violated)
+            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
+                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
+        verdicts[a] = verdict
+        out_lines.append(
+            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
+            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
+            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
+        if arm.fallback_trials:
+            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
+                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
+        if reasons:
+            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
+        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
+            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
+            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    if details:
+        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
+        out_lines.extend(details)
+        out_lines.append("")
+    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    for a in order:
+        arm = arms[a]
+        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
+        if not items:
+            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
+            continue
+        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
+        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
+        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    return state, verdicts
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
+    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
+        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
+    if not suites:
+        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    for s in suites:
+        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
+            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 2
+        st = {}
+        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
+        if os.path.isfile(sp):
+            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
+        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
+            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
+                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
+                  file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+
+    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
+    if args.partial:
+        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
+                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
+    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
+              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
+              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
+              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
+    for s in suites:
+        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
+    print(args.out)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
+#
+# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
+# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
+# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
+#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
+#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
+#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
+#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
+#
+# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
+#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
+#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
+#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
+#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
+#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
+#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
+#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
+#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
+#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
+#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
+#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
+#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
+#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
+#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
+#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
+#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
+#
+# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
+#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
+#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
+#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
+#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
+#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
+#
+# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
+#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
+#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
+#
+# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
+# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
+# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
+CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
+DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
+CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
+# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
+# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
+SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
+
+SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
+CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
+DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
+
+usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
+die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
+    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
+    --help|-h) usage ;;
+    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
+case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
+[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"
+[[ "$CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "--concurrency must be 1-9"
+[[ "$RETRY_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || die "--retry-wait must be whole seconds"
+[[ "$MODEL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || die "--model has unexpected characters"
+[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || die "--source-commit must be a hex commit id"
+for tool in git jq yq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
+
+SUITE_FILE="$EVALS_DIR/suites/$SUITE.yaml"
+[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
+TASK_PREFIX="review"; [[ "$SUITE" == "audit-recall" ]] && TASK_PREFIX="audit"
+
+IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
+IFS=',' read -r -a FIXTURES <<<"$FIXTURES_CSV"
+[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
+[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
+for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
+  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
+  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
+    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
+done

+  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
+  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
+  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
+  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
+  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
+        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
+    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
+  fi
+done
+
+SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
+  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
+SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
+WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"
+
+[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
+[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
+SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
+BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"
+
+# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
+# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
+# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
+verify_corpus() {
+  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
+import hashlib, os, sys
+corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
+raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
+bad = []
+for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
+    if not line.strip():
+        continue
+    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
+    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
+                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
+        continue
+    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
+    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
+        bad.append(rel)
+if bad:
+    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(1)
+print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
+PY
+}
+CORPUS_DIGEST="$(verify_corpus)" || die "fixture corpus does not match SHA256SUMS (run build/seed with --check first)"
+
+# --- the planned trials (interleaved: trial-major, then fixture, then arm) ----
+PLAN=()
+for t in $(seq 1 "$TRIALS"); do
+  for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
+    for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do PLAN+=("$a|$f|$t"); done
